sn45.152:1.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave rukkho pācīnaninno pācī napoṇo pācīnapabbhāro ||
sn45.152:1.3: Yena bhante ninno yena poṇo yena pabbhāro ti || || 3.
sn45.152:1.4: Evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bhāvento a- a- maggam bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro || ||
sn45.152:1.5: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu a- a- maggam bhāvento a- a- maggam bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro || || 4.
sn45.152:1.6: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti viveka[pe] la || sammāsamādhim bhāveti viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || ||
